featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Escapeverse and chose the "Murder on Eclipse Express" room. Based on the marketing and hype around their use of advanced technology and sensors, I had high expectations. Unfortunately, the experience did not justify the price we paid.

While the room does use a few sensors and automated mechanisms to unlock doors, the technology itself is quite limited and does not significantly enhance the gameplay. The "latest technology" claim feels exaggerated compared to what is actually offered inside the room.

The biggest disappointment was the storyline. As a murder mystery-themed escape room, I expected a logical and engaging investigation. Instead, many of the conclusions required players to make unrealistic assumptions, and the story progression often felt disconnected from the clues provided. Rather than rewarding logical thinking, several puzzles seemed to rely on guesswork. A good escape room should make players feel like detectives solving a mystery, but that feeling was largely missing here.

The room theme was "Murder on Eclipse Express," yet there was very little that made us feel like we were actually on a train. The ambience, setup, and overall immersion did not effectively support the theme. The train environment felt underdeveloped, which made it harder to connect with the story.

Another point worth mentioning is the room size. The space is quite limited and is best suited for 2–3 participants. Larger groups may find it cramped, with some members having little to do during certain parts of the game.

The overall condition of the premises was also disappointing. If you visit, I would recommend using the lift instead of the stairs, as the staircase were dirty and lighting was not there during our visit. Additionally, there were ants outside the room entrance, and some even got into my shoes, causing discomfort after leaving from venue. Basic cleanliness and hygiene around the venue should be maintained more carefully though inside cleanliness was good.

Finally, I was surprised by the handling of the payment receipt. After making payment, I requested a receipt but was initially told it could not be provided. It was only shared the following day via WhatsApp. A receipt should ideally be issued immediately upon payment.

Overall, I found Escapeverse to be significantly overhyped. The technology, storyline, immersion, venue maintenance, and customer service did not meet expectations for the amount charged. There is definitely room for improvement, particularly in creating a more logical story, enhancing the thematic experience, maintaining better hygiene, and providing a smoother customer experience.

Ah, Mahim Beach! It’s one of the more understated beaches in Mumbai, compared to its more famous counterparts like Juhu or Marine Drive, but it has its own charm.

### Mahim Beach Overview:
- **Location**: Situated in the Mahim area, this beach offers a quiet escape from the hustle and bustle of Mumbai city. It's located near the Mahim Causeway, making it fairly accessible.

- **Scenic View**: The beach offers views of the Arabian Sea, but the surrounding environment isn’t as pristine as some of the more popular beaches in Mumbai. There's a view of the Mahim Bay and the Bandra-Worli Sea Link from a distance, though it’s not as iconic as the one from the Bandra Sea Face area.

- **Atmosphere**: It’s generally a quieter spot compared to other beaches. On weekdays, it’s calm, but on weekends, it can attract some locals. You’ll find people strolling, playing cricket, or simply sitting and enjoying the breeze. However, the beach isn’t the cleanest, which can be a turn-off for some visitors.

- **Activities**: While Mahim Beach isn't particularly famous for water sports, you can often find people walking along the shore or kids playing. It’s more of a spot for relaxation and casual visits.

- **Nearby Attractions**: The famous **Mahim Dargah** is located close to the beach, which is a popular religious site. There are also some cafes and small eateries nearby, so grabbing a bite is never a problem.

### Pros:
- **Less Crowded**: Compared to other beaches like Juhu or Marine Drive, Mahim Beach tends to be less crowded, offering a more laid-back experience.
- **Local Vibe**: The area feels authentically Mumbai, with local vendors, small shops, and residents going about their daily lives.

### Cons:
- **Cleanliness**: The beach isn’t as well-maintained as other tourist-heavy beaches in the city. You may find some litter and debris around the shore.
- **Water Quality**: Like many other Mumbai beaches, the water quality isn’t great for swimming. It's not the most ideal beach for water activities.

### Final Thoughts:
Mahim Beach isn’t the most glamorous beach in Mumbai, but it offers a quieter, local experience. If you’re looking for a more peaceful, off-the-beaten-path location to unwind, it's a good choice. Just keep your expectations in check regarding cleanliness and amenities.

Mahim Fort, located in the Mahim area of Mumbai, is one of the lesser-known historical sites in the city. Built by the Portuguese in the 16th century, it originally served as a strategic military outpost. However, over time, the fort fell into disrepair and now exists in a somewhat dilapidated state, making it less of a tourist attraction compared to other forts in Mumbai like Gateway of India or Bandra Fort.

### Key Aspects:
1. **Historical Significance**: The fort was originally constructed by the Portuguese in 1680 to defend the area from the Marathas. It was later taken over by the British in the 18th century. It’s interesting from a historical standpoint, though not much of the original structure remains intact.

2. **Location**: Mahim Fort is located near the Mahim Beach, which is a busy part of Mumbai. The fort itself is tucked away in a residential area, which means it’s not a prominent tourist spot and can sometimes be overlooked.

3. **Condition**: The fort is in poor condition and lacks proper maintenance. Most of the fort’s structure is reduced to ruins, and it’s surrounded by modern buildings. It doesn't offer the same panoramic views or grandeur as other forts, which can make it less appealing to those looking for a more scenic or fully preserved historical experience.

4. **Accessibility**: The fort is accessible to the public, but you’ll likely need to search for it amidst local streets and residential buildings. It’s not as well-marked as other historical sites in Mumbai, so visiting may require a little bit of patience and exploration.

5. **Cultural Context**: While the fort itself may not be a major draw for tourists, the area around it offers a glimpse into the local life of Mumbai, with its mix of residential homes and bustling markets. It’s a good place to experience the contrast between Mumbai's rich history and its modern-day hustle and bustle.

### Overall Review:
Mahim Fort can be an interesting visit for history buffs or those looking to explore off-the-beaten-path locations in Mumbai. However, if you're expecting a well-preserved, tourist-friendly fort, you might be disappointed. It's a quiet spot, perfect for those looking for a peaceful break from the busy city, but it's not a must-see if you're short on time.

customer_updates.name: Samarth Sankpal
customer_updates.text: I had a great time at The Game Palacio! The variety of electronic games and the bowling alley is the best. The staff is  friendly and helpful and ensures everyone has a great experience. This place is good for  kids and adults. It is clean, well-maintained and  very affordable. I will definitely return with my friends and family! ❤️⚡️

customer_updates.text: The Game Luxe, a great place for bowling and food

featured_reviews.name: Eram Faridi
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Game Palacio Kurla, and it was an amazing experience. The ambience is stylish, the gaming options are fantastic, and the staff is very cooperative. From arcade games to bowling and VR activities, everything is well-maintained and enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Khakhrodia
featured_reviews.review_text: Game Palacio Kurla is a must-visit. It successfully merges a luxury lounge with a high-octane gaming zone. If you want a day filled with "games, arcade, good food, and drinks," this is easily one of the best spots in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: yangmi makang
featured_reviews.review_text: The bowling was a great experience, amazing ambiance, well equipped with the game tools and well maintained, cleanliness was good. Well indeed, it's a good place where you can hang out, which staff's professionalism elevate hospitality but I could definitely notice the lack of professionalism in staff and that's  a big concern to work on in.

featured_reviews.name: Ajish Narayan
featured_reviews.review_text: We Hosted our company party at Game Palacio Kurla location and it was an absolute blast! The atmosphere was vibrant and the perfect mix of competition and socializing. The gaming area was fantastic—our team loved specific bowling/arcade. Huge shoutout to Ms. Namrata who helped us through out the event and the staff for keeping the drinks flowing and the energy high. The food was surprisingly great for a gaming venue, especially fish finger. Highly recommend for a fun, stress-free team event!!!

featured_reviews.name: Harshvardhan kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: It was our first time for Bowling. There is no prior reservation required it is first come first serve basis. Since it was weekend we were charged 500+ taxes with buy one get one offer and this offer is from morning uptil 4 PM, 20 balls each player. It was a fun experience though and you can visit with ur friends here. On one bowling track four players can play together. There is screen above which tells u about score among players. There are other games too and for which u need to pay different charges. There is attached resto- bar where you can enjoy meal( it has its own menu and need to pay according to menu). Overall it was an amazing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Krishna Madhwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Game Palacio. The overall vibe of the place is great, but the service completely ruined it for us.

The staff (Sumit) was extremely rude and unprofessional. We were pressured to place our food order because the staff wanted to close the kitchen — even though it was still one hour before the official closing time. Instead of politely informing us about last order timings, the approach was pushy and disrespectful.

When customers visit a premium place, they expect basic courtesy and professionalism. Unfortunately, that was missing here. Management seriously needs to train their staff on customer handling and hospitality.

Very disappointed with the service experience. Would think twice before visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: LM Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: In case one wants to enjoy good music, food and bowling alley all at one place, this is the place. Great crowd. Alcohol, cocktails and mocktail are served. Waiting for your chance of bowling may take up to an hour during weekends.

featured_reviews.name: Gopal Bokka
featured_reviews.review_text: We went for dinning and bowling. We did not expect the ambience would be so good. Loved 🥰the whole experience Specially thanks to Mr.Aniket as a RM he made a cocktail 🍸 for me 🥂🍾The staff was very helpfull.

featured_reviews.name: Inderjeet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Too expensive. If you solve some puzzle before it was intended, you can never solve other puzzles. Only 3-4 people should be allowed, 9 people were crowded in one small room.

featured_reviews.name: Manohar Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place for treasure hunt. You can find out different game in which you have to find all the clue in one hour to come out from game.

featured_reviews.name: bhumika thakur
featured_reviews.review_text: Super Fun and very challenging! We escaped with 7 minutes to spare! Lots of clues and locks and you do get hints! Great experience.If you are looking for a fun family activity that is memorable and challenges you at the same time I highly recommend giving this a try.

featured_reviews.name: Harshavardhan Baheti
featured_reviews.review_text: It's an absolutely fun place to go to. The concept is awesome, you can take hints if you are stuck somewhere in the process of leaving. The setting is very adventurous, filled with elements of thrill. The price is also pretty decent and there's options for pre-book on their official website. I rate this place 9.5/10

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Gada
featured_reviews.review_text: Good fun to crack clues with a group in a kind of treasure hunt. Five different levels available. Themes however don't really add too much to the experience. At least it did not for the one we opted. There are 3 hints given based on your request, which is helpful to achieve the goal (we did in the difficult level). 75 minutes including theme video and waiting time, actual time inside the rooms is 60 minutes. It is opposite Kidzania, next to Punjab Grill on the 3rd floor of R City Mall. Will definitely visit again. Highly recommended for treasure hunt enthusiasts.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja G
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was fun to b here. We had taken "London calling" as our choice.
really good tactics used. Loved  the ambiance. Liked the  staff support.

featured_reviews.name: SHARON XAVIER
featured_reviews.review_text: Great Experience Today @Escapalogy ! Extremely fun and exciting with the clues ! The kids enjoyed every moment ! Looking forward to come and play the other themes as well.  I want to mainly appreciate and thank the staff for being so supportive and making it so easy for me as I had my younger daughter too ! Superb staff !
